types.name: CompressionInfo
docs: SDK CompressionInfo - a compact 24-byte struct for custom zero-copy PDAs.
This is the lightweight version of compression info used in the SDK.
CToken has its own compression handling via `light_compressible::CompressionInfo`.
# Memory Layout (24 bytes with #[repr(C)])
- `last_claimed_slot`: u64 @ offset 0 (8 bytes, 8-byte aligned)
- `lamports_per_write`: u32 @ offset 8 (4 bytes)
- `config_version`: u16 @ offset 12 (2 bytes)
- `state`: CompressionState @ offset 14 (1 byte)
- `_padding`: u8 @ offset 15 (1 byte)
- `rent_config`: RentConfig @ offset 16 (8 bytes, 2-byte aligned)
Fields are ordered for optimal alignment to achieve exactly 24 bytes.

fields.name: last_claimed_slot
docs: Slot when rent was last claimed (epoch boundary accounting).

fields.name: lamports_per_write
docs: Lamports to top up on each write (from config, stored per-account to avoid passing config on every write)

fields.name: config_version
docs: Version of the compressible config used to initialize this account.

fields.name: state
docs: Account compression state.

fields.name: rent_config
docs: Rent function parameters for determining compressibility/claims.

types.name: CompressionState
docs: Compression state for SDK CompressionInfo.
This enum uses #[repr(u8)] for Pod compatibility:
- Uninitialized = 0 (default, account not yet set up)
- Decompressed = 1 (account is decompressed/active on Solana)
- Compressed = 2 (account is compressed in Merkle tree)

types.name: CreateAccountsProof
docs: Proof data for instruction params when creating new compressed accounts.
Used in the INIT flow - pass directly to instruction data.
All accounts use the same address tree, so only one `address_tree_info` is needed.

fields.name: proof
docs: The validity proof.

fields.name: address_tree_info
docs: Single packed address tree info (all accounts use same tree).

fields.name: output_state_tree_index
docs: Output state tree index for new compressed accounts.

fields.name: state_tree_index
docs: State merkle tree index (needed for mint creation decompress validation).
This is optional to maintain backwards compatibility.

fields.name: system_accounts_offset
docs: Offset in remaining_accounts where Light system accounts start.

fields.name: create_accounts_proof
docs: Combined proof for:
assigned address 0 = Thread Light-PDA
assigned address 1 = Message compressed account

types.name: DecompressIdempotentParams
docs: Parameters for decompress_idempotent instruction.
Generic over the variant type - each program defines its own `PackedProgramAccountVariant`.
Field order matches `LoadAccountsData` from light-client for compatibility.

fields.name: system_accounts_offset
docs: Offset into remaining_accounts where Light system accounts begin

fields.name: token_accounts_offset
docs: Accounts before this offset are PDA accounts, at and after are token accounts.
Set to accounts.len() if no token accounts.

fields.name: output_queue_index
docs: Packed index of the output queue in remaining_accounts.

fields.name: proof
docs: Validity proof for compressed account verification

fields.name: accounts
docs: Accounts to decompress - wrapped in CompressedAccountData for metadata

fields.name: kind
docs: [Kind](InboxKind) of the inbox.

fields.name: _padding
docs: Padding to make the next field 8-byte aligned.

fields.name: version
docs: Version of the account.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the inbox

fields.name: id
docs: Unique identifier for the inbox. The combination of (owner, id) must be unique.

fields.name: index
docs: Index of the inbox page.
- when [InboxKind] is Ephemeral, index is always 0.
- When [InboxKind] is Standard, index starts from 0 and increments by 1 when the current page is full.

fields.name: len
docs: Number of threads in the current inbox.
- when [InboxKind] is Ephemeral, len is total threads ever created.
- When [InboxKind] is Standard, len is number of threads in the current page.

fields.name: last_updated
docs: Timestamp of the last update to the inbox.(received threads only)

fields.name: payment_rule
docs: (Optional) payment wall for the inbox.

types.name: InitConfigParams
docs: Configuration parameters for initializing compression config.
Field order matches SDK client's `InitializeCompressionConfigAnchorData`.

types.name: Message
docs: `Message` struct represents a message sent from one party to another.
associated with [`Thread`].
PDA derivation : `["msg", thread_id, msg_seq]`

fields.name: discriminator
docs: Unique identifier for the [`Message`] compressed account to be able to queried from Photon RPC

fields.name: version
docs: Version of the account.

fields.name: thread_id
docs: Thread id associated with the message.

fields.name: msg_seq
docs: Message sequence number in the thread, starting from 1.

fields.name: sender_side
docs: sender side

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Timestamp of when the message was sent

fields.name: payment
docs: Optional payment information associated with the message.

fields.name: message_type
docs: Type of the message content

fields.name: content
docs: Actual content of the message, stored as a byte vector.
Client should be able to deserialize the content based on the message type.

types.name: PackedActivitySeeds
docs: Packed seeds with u8 indices for Activity PDA.

types.name: PackedAddressTreeInfo
docs: Packed address tree info for instruction data.
Contains indices to address tree accounts and root index.

types.name: PackedLightAccountVariant
docs: Program-wide packed variant enum for efficient serialization.

types.name: RentConfig
docs: Rent function parameters,
used to calculate whether the account is compressible.

fields.name: base_rent
docs: Base rent constant: rent = base_rent + num_bytes * lamports_per_byte_per_epoch

fields.name: max_top_up
docs: Maximum lamports that can be charged per top-up operation.
Protects against griefing by accounts with high lamports_per_write.

types.name: Segment
docs: [`Segment`] is a fixed-size container for thread ids.
`N` is the byte size of the segment, must be a multiple of [`THREAD_ID_BYTES`] (4).
It provides efficient operations to maintain a recency-ordered list of thread ids.
with O(1) insertions and O(S) spill when full, where S is the spill size.

fields.name: raw
docs: Packed u32 thread ids, index 0 = newest.

fields.name: create_accounts_proof
docs: Single proof for:
assigned address 0 = Message compressed account

fields.name: create_accounts_proof_with_archive
docs: Combined proof for:
assigned address 0 = Message compressed account
assigned address 1 = InboxArchive compressed account

types.name: Thread
docs: `Thread` struct represents a conversation thread between two parties.
- PDA derivation : `["thread", thread_id]`

fields.name: version
docs: Version of the account.

fields.name: last_sender_side
docs: Indicates which party sent the last message in the thread.
0 = from, 1 = to

fields.name: id
docs: Global unique thread id

fields.name: from
docs: Wallet address of the first party in the conversation thread.

fields.name: to
docs: Wallet address of the second party in the conversation thread.

fields.name: inbox_id
docs: Optional inbox id.
If the [`Thread`] is associated with an [`Inbox`], this field will be inbox_id, otherwise u64::MAX.

fields.name: total_msgs
docs: Message count for the `from` and `to` wallet addresses

fields.name: last_msg_seq
docs: Sequence number of the last message in the thread

fields.name: last_updated
docs: Timestamp of the last message in the thread

fields.name: last_read_seq_from
docs: Last read message sequence number for the `from` wallet address.

fields.name: last_read_seq_to
docs: Last read message sequence number for the `to` wallet address.

fields.name: escrow_payment
docs: Optional escrow payment info for the thread
